title: How to Cancel Headspace — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Headspace subscription on iPhone, Android, or web. Stop the $12.99/mo charge and keep access to free content.
intro: Headspace cancellation depends on where you subscribed — Apple, Google, or directly through Headspace. You keep access to some free content (basics course) after canceling.

steps.title: Determine where you subscribed
steps.text: Check your billing: Apple subscription shows in iOS Settings → Subscriptions. Google shows in Play Store → Subscriptions. If neither, you subscribed on headspace.com directly.
steps.tip: Most mobile users subscribed through Apple or Google, even if they don't remember doing so.

steps.title: Cancel through the correct platform
steps.text: For Apple: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions → Headspace → Cancel. For Google: Play Store → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Headspace → Cancel. For web: headspace.com/settings/subscription → Cancel.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Tap "Confirm" or "Cancel subscription" on the confirmation dialog. Your Premium access continues until the end of your billing period.

steps.title: Verify cancellation
steps.text: Check for a confirmation email or verify in your subscription settings that the renewal is turned off. Your next billing date should show as the end date.
steps.tip: After cancellation, Headspace's free tier still offers a limited Basics course and some sleep content.

warnings: The cancellation method depends entirely on where you originally subscribed (Apple, Google, or web).
Canceling on headspace.com does NOT cancel Apple/Google subscriptions — you'll still be charged.
Your meditation stats and favorites are preserved if you re-subscribe.
If you have a corporate/employee wellness benefit, check with HR before paying out of pocket.

faqs.q: Will I lose my meditation progress if I cancel?
faqs.a: No. Your stats, streaks, favorites, and completed courses are all preserved. You can access them again if you re-subscribe.

faqs.q: Is there free content on Headspace?
faqs.a: Yes. The free tier includes the Basics course (introductory meditations), some sleep sounds, and limited content. It's enough to maintain a basic practice.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Headspace?
faqs.a: For Apple/Google subscriptions, request refunds through their platforms. For direct web subscriptions, contact Headspace support within a few days of the charge.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Headspace?
faqs.a: Insight Timer (free with 100k+ meditations), YouTube meditation channels, and the built-in Breathe app on Apple Watch are excellent free alternatives.

refund.details: Refunds depend on your billing platform. Apple: reportaproblem.apple.com. Google: Play Store refund request. Direct: contact Headspace support within a few days of charge.

retentionTactics: Headspace may offer a discounted annual rate.
They show your meditation streak and total minutes practiced.
They may offer a free month to continue.
